definition.signal_pool: selected classical tops/bottoms/H&S, triangles/rectangle/wedges, flags, triple tops/bottoms
definition.currency_trend: equal-weight mean log return of each currency across available FX pairs, oriented base positive and quote negative
definition.gold_trend: XAUUSD log return; confirms XAUUSD direction and the historical inverse USD relationship only for USD pairs
definition.timing: filter uses signal-bar close or older observations; entry is next bar open
definition.exit: strict RR 1:1 full exit; same-bar ambiguity is loss
definition.non_usd_crosses: gold gate passes through because no universal directional mapping was assumed

selection: horizon selected independently per filter using 2010-2018 and 2019-2022 only
